name: Priya Raman
headline: Senior Product Manager
Payments · Marketplaces · AI
summary: Product manager with 11 years across marketplaces, payments and data. Owns the checkout roadmap for Northwind Market, a fictional marketplace with 4M monthly buyers, and previously led merchant onboarding at Bluefin Pay. Works closely with engineering, risk and operations, decides with experiments, and uses AI to speed up discovery.

experience.title: Senior Product Manager, Checkout
experience.context: Fictional marketplace used for this sample: 4M monthly buyers, 60k sellers.

bullets.x: Buyers abandoned checkout when their saved card failed
bullets.y: launched UPI and wallet fallback with one-tap retry
bullets.z: lifting checkout conversion 18% in two quarters

bullets.x: Card-testing attacks were slipping past static rules
bullets.y: shipped velocity checks and a manual-review queue with risk ops
bullets.z: avoiding an estimated $12M in fraud losses a year

bullets.x: Order-status questions made up 40% of support tickets
bullets.y: defined an LLM help assistant grounded in order data with human handoff

bullets.x: Five teams competed for the same checkout surface
bullets.y: set up a shared quarterly roadmap and acceptance criteria

experience.title: Product Manager, Merchant Onboarding
experience.context: Fictional payment gateway used for this sample.

bullets.x: New merchants waited nine days for KYC approval
bullets.y: automated document checks and added a status tracker

bullets.x: Small merchants churned over unclear fees
bullets.y: introduced flat-rate pricing with a fee calculator

bullets.x: Activation emails had a 6% open rate
bullets.y: ran A/B tests on timing and content

bullets.x: Weekly sales reports took two days to compile
bullets.y: automated them in SQL and Tableau
